description: This Java class 'ProductImages' extends 'ContentFiles' and manages product image data by associating image files with a specific product ID.

classes.name: ProductImages
classes.description: Represents images related to a product, extending ContentFiles with a specific product ID.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the product ID associated with this set of product images.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product ID for this set of product images.
